Definition: from G3739 and G4007; who especially:--whomsoever.
BiblicalUsage: Hósper is the word behind 'whomsoever' in Mark 15:6, where Pilate released one prisoner at the feast, 'whomsoever they desired.' The Greek text behind the King James Version reads honper there, the one word; the SBL text reads hon with an, the same sense in two words, so this word stands in the King James Version only.
TheologicalSignificance: I take hósper as it stands: whomsoever, the very one they asked for.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
